name: Cocoyam Leaf Blight
description: A devastating fungal-like disease causing large brown lesions on cocoyam leaves. It can destroy entire leaf canopies within days under favorable conditions, severely reducing corm yield.
symptoms: Water-soaked circular spots on leaves, starting from margins
Spots rapidly enlarging into large brown necrotic lesions
Rot can spread to petioles and corms
causes: Dense plantings with poor air circulation
treatments: Apply copper-based fungicides (copper oxychloride) at first symptoms
Spray metalaxyl or mancozeb at 7-10 day intervals
Remove and destroy severely infected leaves
prevention: Plant resistant or tolerant cocoyam varieties
Space plants adequately for air circulation
Practice crop rotation with non-host crops
Remove volunteer plants and crop debris
